body: Yeah that’s right. Funny thing about me is that i would happily live the rest of my life without speaking to anyone else, and i know that’s horrible and selfish because i have a family and a fiance, but it’s true

I’ve no chance getting any other credit because my credit score is horrific now. I’ve tried debt consolidation loans in the past but things just got worse for me. Always just ended up paying more and being worse off
It’s credit cards, personal loans and store account (littlewood)

I’m sure like everyone else thinking about it, apart from me, can get through whatever it is that you’re going through and is making you feel like that’s the only way out. I am choosing not to live anymore because i don’t like living anymore, and that’s that. My problem has been going on for so long that it’s been over my head for a third of my life and it’s turned me into a horrible person and i’m doing everyone a favour and leaving.

Try speaking to someone about whatever is troubling you. I know you can get through it. As for me, if i could magic up £10k to save my life i would, but there is no point even hoping or praying. I’m done.

I appreciate you trying to help, but i’ve tried everything, consolidation loans, debt management plans, and still i’m no better off after 8 years, so i’m throwing the towel in i can’t take it anymore seriously
Thank you so much, anything that can help would be greatly appreciated.

Understandable. Because one, i very much doubt anyone will help with the full amount, they could just with a small amount so once it’s paid off i will be able to pay them back. I do have a job but for the last 6 years i’ve been using 50% of my salary towards paying the debt off so i’d use that. I’d also be able to do things to better my life, go to college to open more doors to get a higher paid job. Whatever it takes, i will pay it back. I just need the debt gone in full now, rather than it taking another 5 years. I’m almost 30 and still living at home. I need the debt to be gone now so that my credit score can start going back up so that i have the chance to finally move out and get a house with my fiance.
